prompt: What does clip.loop(Clip.LOOP_CONTINUOUSLY) do for an audio Clip?
choices: Plays the clip once at double speed
Repeats the audio clip indefinitely until clip.stop() is called
Creates a loopback test for the audio hardware
explanation: Clip.LOOP_CONTINUOUSLY = -1, meaning loop forever. clip.loop(3) would loop 3 additional times (plays 4 total). Use clip.stop() to end playback and clip.setFramePosition(0) to reset to the start.
